description: Foundation: TypeScript path alias, shared lib bootstrap (env + Prisma client singleton), the full Prisma schema from design.md §3 (output to src/generated/prisma to match the existing eslint ignore), a seed script (one ADMIN from env + sample watch products), and SETUP.md documenting the DB fallback. Covers tasks.md tasks 1-2. Prerequisite for all other features.
steps: Add 'baseUrl': '.' and 'paths': { '@/*': ['./src/*'] } to compilerOptions in c:/Users/HP/Desktop/Dawns Embrace/tsconfig.json so later imports use @/lib/... etc.

Create prisma/schema.prisma: datasource db { provider = 'postgresql'; url = env('DATABASE_URL') }; generator client { provider = 'prisma-client-js'; output = '../src/generated/prisma' }. Implement enums Role {CUSTOMER ADMIN} and OrderStatus {PENDING PAID APPROVED PROCESSING SHIPPED DELIVERED CANCELLED} and models User, VerificationToken, Address, Product, Order, OrderItem, OrderStatusEvent, Notification EXACTLY per design.md §3 (prices as Int kobo: Product.priceKobo, Order.totalKobo, OrderItem.unitPriceKobo). Add the Address.orders Order[] back-relation Prisma requires for Order.address.

Create src/lib/env.ts: typed accessors for the env vars in design.md §10 (DATABASE_URL, NEXTAUTH_SECRET, NEXTAUTH_URL, PAYSTACK_SECRET_KEY, PAYSTACK_PUBLIC_KEY, CLOUDINARY_* , RESEND_API_KEY, EMAIL_FROM, ADMIN_EMAIL, plus ADMIN_PASSWORD for seed). Throw a clear error at use-site when a required var is missing (not at module import time).
Create src/lib/prisma.ts: PrismaClient singleton (globalThis-cached in dev to avoid hot-reload leaks) importing from '@/generated/prisma'.

Create prisma/seed.ts: upsert one ADMIN User from ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD env (bcryptjs-hashed passwordHash, role ADMIN, emailVerified = new Date()) and ~4 sample watch Products (varied dialColor, kobo priceKobo, stock, placeholder imageUrl e.g. a Cloudinary demo or '/brand/hero-watch.jpg', isActive true). Make it idempotent (upsert by unique email / product name).

Add to package.json: a 'prisma' key with 'seed' invoking the TS seeder in a Windows-safe way (add devDependency 'tsx' pinned, seed = 'tsx prisma/seed.ts'); add scripts 'db:migrate': 'prisma migrate dev' and 'db:seed': 'prisma db seed'.

Create SETUP.md at project root documenting: required .env keys (copy from .env.example), that there is no local Postgres on this machine, and the manual steps to run against a real DB: 'npx prisma migrate dev --name init' then 'npx prisma db seed'. Note the DB-not-reachable fallback explicitly.
acceptance_criteria: 'npx prisma validate' reports the schema is valid.
'npx prisma generate' writes a client into src/generated/prisma and 'npx tsc --noEmit' passes with src/lib/prisma.ts importing from '@/generated/prisma'.
The @/* alias resolves in a sample import (tsc passes).
prisma/seed.ts type-checks and defines one ADMIN user plus multiple sample watch products.
SETUP.md documents the migrate+seed steps and the DB-unreachable fallback.
verification: cd 'c:/Users/HP/Desktop/Dawns Embrace'; npx prisma validate; npx prisma generate; npx tsc --noEmit; npx next lint
Optionally 'npx prisma migrate dev --name init' — if it fails for an unreachable DATABASE_URL, record that in findings and SETUP.md and continue; do NOT fail the feature on it.
findings:
DONE. Verification: prisma validate OK, prisma generate OK, tsc --noEmit clean, next lint clean, next build succeeded. For later features:
- Prisma client is generated to src/generated/prisma; import it as `import { PrismaClient } from "@/generated/prisma"`. The shared singleton lives at src/lib/prisma.ts (named export `prisma`) — use `import { prisma } from "@/lib/prisma"` everywhere; do not instantiate PrismaClient ad hoc. Regenerate (`npx prisma generate`) after any schema change.
- Enums `Role` (CUSTOMER|ADMIN) and `OrderStatus` (PENDING|PAID|APPROVED|PROCESSING|SHIPPED|DELIVERED|CANCELLED) are exported from @/generated/prisma. Prisma string-union style is used in seed (e.g. role: "ADMIN"); importing the enum objects also works.
- Typed env accessors in src/lib/env.ts: `import { env } from "@/lib/env"` then `env.databaseUrl`, `env.nextAuthSecret`, `env.nextAuthUrl`, `env.paystackSecretKey`, `env.paystackPublicKey`, `env.cloudinaryCloudName`, `env.cloudinaryApiKey`, `env.cloudinaryApiSecret`, `env.resendApiKey`, `env.emailFrom`, `env.adminEmail`, `env.adminPassword`. Each getter throws at use-site (not import time) if the var is missing. `env.optional(name)` returns string|undefined without throwing.
- Path alias '@/*' -> './src/*' added to tsconfig.json (baseUrl '.').
- Seed runner: `tsx` (pinned 4.23.15) added as devDependency; package.json has `prisma.seed = "tsx prisma/seed.ts"` plus scripts `db:migrate` (prisma migrate dev) and `db:seed` (prisma db seed). Seed is idempotent: admin upsert by email, products upsert-by-name (findFirst+update/create). Seed requires ADMIN_EMAIL and ADMIN_PASSWORD env vars.
- .env.example gained ADMIN_PASSWORD. A gitignored local .env was created with placeholder values so prisma validate/generate/build run locally (prisma could not load config without DATABASE_URL being set).
- Added '/src/generated/' to .gitignore (was only in eslint ignores before; the generated client is NOT committed).
- DB FALLBACK CONFIRMED: no local Postgres/Docker on this machine. `npx prisma migrate dev --name init` fails with a connection error to localhost:5432 (exit 1) — expected and documented in SETUP.md. `npx prisma db seed` will likewise fail until a reachable DATABASE_URL exists. prisma validate + prisma generate serve as the schema verification. Do NOT treat the migrate/seed connection failure as a schema bug.
- Sample data: 1 ADMIN user + 4 active watch products (Blue/Green/White/Black dials; priceKobo integers; imageUrl pointing at /brand/*.jpg placeholders).
